hardware: one executor: Linux 6.17 aarch64, 20 cores; CPython 3.12.3 (and 3.10.21 for the floor runs)

cross_process.mechanism: multiprocessing 'spawn' — each participant is its own interpreter process that opens the workspace from disk and authenticates with a credential; OS-level barriers and events; assertions read the durable journal

cases.last capacity / same task: 3 rounds x 2 processes (+2 on the same task)
cases.revocation between worker and commit: 1 barrier-ordered round with the REAL worker → REFUSED_APPROVAL_REVOKED, revocation recorded first
cases.free admission/revocation races: 4 rounds → never an admission after the revocation
cases.stale form: a server process and an amending process, event-ordered → HTTP 422 E_STALE_SELECTION, no packet
cases.two different attempts and a reveal: 4 rounds x 3 processes → one attempt each; the reveal arrived first in 3 of 4 rounds on the recorded run and was refused each time
cases.staged input rewritten in place: one writer process alternating two complete valid 300 kB bundles while the REAL restricted worker verified 30 times: 30 refused INPUT_CHANGED_DURING_READ, 0 results for other bytes; then 3 calm runs accepted

crash_boundaries.mechanism: a child process is killed with SIGKILL inside the journal append: BEFORE the write, after HALF the line (synced), or AFTER the synced line
invariants: 0 or 1 new event exactly as the mode implies
a torn tail refuses writes until recovery and its bytes are preserved
reserved minutes = sum of live reservations, remaining never negative
no comparison without a durable attempt
the retry with the same operation id yields exactly one event
crash_boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: behaviour under physical power loss (disk cache, file system): not staged, not claimed

upload_entry.hostile_delimiter_body: about 6.6 MB made of 600001 delimiters → HTTP 400 before any split; time and peak-memory growth are asserted (< 5 s, < 96 MiB)
upload_entry.unfavorable_outcome: before the fix, 2 of the 160 mutants (non-ASCII bytes in the CSRF field) ended in an unhandled TypeError and a dropped connection; nothing was written. Fixed; the test now fails on any dropped connection

sensitivity.mechanism: one exact text replacement per disposable copy of the packages; fake HOME and own TMPDIR; the named test must fail by assertion; the unmodified copy passes; candidate files hashed before and after; copies deleted
sensitivity.unfavorable_outcome: the first run showed one control (session ownership) whose removal failed NO test; a test was added and the variant is now detected

isolation_bounds.cpu_limit: a spinning worker is ended by RLIMIT_CPU (20 s) with the wall-clock bound set to 45 s
isolation_bounds.descriptor_limit: part of the required live probe

unsupported_environment: SIMULATED: a seccomp filter makes the kernel's three Landlock calls answer ENOSYS and PATH holds no bubblewrap; the unpatched product refuses admission with REFUSED_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE and serves everything else. Not a macOS or Windows run.
not_advice: Research and education only. Not investment advice.
